segmentPatterns.label: Direct Quote Archival Montage
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: The subject makes an audacious or defining claim about themselves in their own voice.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Rapid montage of historical footage and newspaper clippings validating the long duration of the claim.

segmentPatterns.label: Presenter Premise with Life Summary Carousel
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Presenter asks a core foundational question, admitting lack of common knowledge about origins.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Presenter establishes query on camera, alternating rapidly with key milestone portraits and television artifacts.

segmentPatterns.label: Geographic Origin Zoom and Boundary Contrast
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narration identifies birthplace and contrasts it with an adjacent cultural or economic center.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: 2D vector map zooms from macro country level down to regional boundary, highlighting the origin area across a natural barrier.

segmentPatterns.label: Anecdote Re-enactment with Contradictory Punchline
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narrator describes a character-building task, then reveals an ironic twist that contradicts the struggle.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Archival b-roll illustrating the humble task, followed immediately by visual proof of extreme luxury.

segmentPatterns.label: Tactile Highlighter Document Verification
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host quotes a contentious or revealing statement from a published work.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Extreme macro close-up of a printed physical page while a physical yellow marker highlights the exact phrase in real time.

segmentPatterns.label: Spoken Checklist Rapid Montage
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narrator rapidly lists three or four specific accomplishments, disciplines, or criteria in quick succession.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A rapid sequence of 1-to-2-second b-roll shots exactly cut to each listed item, concluding with a cut back to the narrator.

segmentPatterns.label: Presenter Direct Exposition Anchor
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Analytical or interpretive statements synthesizing multiple biographical facts into an editorial thesis.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Medium host talking-head framing with intentional jump-cut reframing or prop presentation to sustain pacing.

segmentPatterns.label: Documentary Quote Callout with Highlighter
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narration delivers a crucial verbatim quote from a source.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Macro shot of physical page with live action or graphic marker highlighting key words precisely in sync.

segmentPatterns.label: Integrated Chapter Checklist Overlay
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host announces an analytical framework or numbered takeaway list.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Presenter remains on screen while a clean animated graphic card tracks numbered topics.

segmentPatterns.label: Boast Corroboration Montage
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Subject claims a personal ability or aspiration.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Interview clip stating boast cuts immediately to historical photo sequence proving or testing it.

segmentPatterns.label: Parallel Realities Juxtaposition
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Subject's sheltered advancement contrasted with broader harsh historical events.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Pristine personal photo portraits cut sharply to visceral combat or hardship b-roll.

segmentPatterns.label: Spatial Record Scan and Row Tracking
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Speaker cites bureaucratic, financial, or legal proof.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Official document moves into frame in 3D perspective, zooming smoothly into the specific line as an animated highlight reveals it.

segmentPatterns.label: Side-by-Side Subject Identity Reveal
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narration introduces key external actors or witnesses.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Dual framed headshots slide into balanced positions with lower-third name tags.

segmentPatterns.label: Document Zoom and Targeted Line Highlight
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claim supported by investigative journalism or primary written records.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Full-document overview zooms into a paragraph, followed by a simulated highlight sweep matching the spoken quote.

segmentPatterns.label: Numbered Thematic List Overlay
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host introduces an analytical framework or numbered mental model.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A stylized list graphic overlays studio footage and populates items with synchronized typewriter animations.

segmentPatterns.label: Thematic Echo Callout
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host claims a subject holds a lifelong belief or phrase.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A brief archival cutaway of the subject uttering the exact phrase live, followed by immediate return to narration.

segmentPatterns.label: Claim-to-Document Proof Escalation
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Historical premise -> audit process -> allegation statement -> direct document proof.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Archival historical montage -> host exposition -> street B-roll -> host holding paper -> macro text insert with practical highlight.

segmentPatterns.label: Host Narration to Physical Document Macro Intercut
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host states an allegation or testimony premise, followed by exact quote read while marker highlights text.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A-roll presenter medium shot cutting rapidly to top-down macro paper insert with live physical highlighter.

segmentPatterns.label: Broadsheet Macro Zoom
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narration cites major media reporting and reads the contemporary headline.

segmentPatterns.label: Timed Document Text Highlighting

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Document zoomed to readable scale with animated marker strokes precisely synchronized to spoken keywords.

segmentPatterns.label: Numbered Thesis Rule Reveal
